dataset: Tabula Sapiens v1 bone marrow, Figshare release v5
citation: The Tabula Sapiens Consortium, Science 376, eabl4896 (2022). doi:10.1126/science.abl4896
sampling: 10X only; stable cell-ID order; cap 150 per donor/published fine label
excluded: Unmapped published classes excluded; no artificial label corruption
limits: Published labels are reference metadata, not independent ground truth. Panels and thresholds are illustrative; no biological accuracy claim. One NK module cannot establish a subtype margin.
bundle_note: Numerical CSVs are unchanged. Absolute path fields in JSON/JSONL are replaced by basenames; original hashes are retained in manifest. Count matrices are retrieved separately with prepare-review.
